nodes.name: Kindwise Health Assessment
nodes.notes: Server-side only — Api-Key comes from services/n8n/.env (CROP_HEALTH_API_KEY), never sent to or stored in the frontend. Request shape verified against flowerchecker/kindwise-api-client (the vendor's own reference client): image is base64 inside the JSON body ($binary.data.data is n8n's own base64 encoding of the downloaded file), details/language are query params. 'treatment' is requested so Map Diagnosis Result can read its prevention/biological sub-keys — its 'chemical' sub-key is deliberately never read downstream.
